name: session-ticker
description: Live board of other same-host Claude sessions: a one-line status per session, colour-coded, with needs-you alerts

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Model used to write each session's teammate-style summary, or 'off' to show only the mechanical last action (no model calls)

summaryEverySeconds.title: Summary interval (seconds)
summaryEverySeconds.description: Minimum seconds between summary refreshes per session

ttlMinutes.title: Drop after (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Drop a session from the board this many minutes after its last update

maxCards.title: Max cards
maxCards.description: Maximum session cards to show (0 = fit to the pane height)
